protocols.protocol.txt:
Exact algebraic elimination of all unconstrained bilateral blocks (point, hinge alignment, springs) from the existing full fixed-geometry relaxation equations. Partition H=J M^-1 J^T+Gamma and g into free f and bounded/unilateral r. Solve lambda_f=-H_ff^-1(g_f+H_fr lambda_r); use S=H_rr-H_rf H_ff^-1 H_fr and q=g_r-H_rf H_ff^-1 g_f for remaining rows. Preserve original Gamma, including spring regularization based on the original prepared masses; do not recompute physical softness from articulated masses.
Before evaluation, require positive-definite H_ff,24random recovered-state/free-residual and Schur-gradient controls<=1e-10scaled, reproduction of the verified root<=1e-9 and original full natural residual<=1e-8. Report matrix sizes/eigenvalues/conditioning and transformed block ranks. Tiny negative Schur eigenvalues may be rounded to zero only in local semidefinite solves at1e-12relative spectral cutoff; actual full equations remain unchanged and independently checked.
Two starts: cold remaining impulses and saved capped remaining impulses, both with exact free-row recovery. Native row/color ordering preserved as a serial prototype; implicit articulation-wide response changes ownership requirements, so existing GPU endpoint coloring cannot simply be reused. At most128complete reduced waves. Exact scalar interval/positive solves, metric disk/ball solves with semidefinite nullspace preserving the nearest feasible old component when objective-flat, paired normal active-set solve with existing1e-5determinant fallback. No threshold or iteration tuning after evaluation.
Require two consecutive quiet reduced waves with full recovered velocity/cache changes<=1e-5 and full original relative natural residual<=1e-8, plus original scaled domain feasibility<=1e-8 and original colored-wave verification<=1e-5. This tests a numerical preconditioner/elimination on the reconstructed phase, not original phase-entry, physical Rain, GPU performance or full qualification. Freeze all failures.
